newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu opposes surprise Jerusalem housing plan.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu opposes surprise Jerusalem housing plan.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is fighting a plan approved by surprise on Thursday to build tens of homes for Jews in the heart of an Arab East Jerusalem neighbourhood, Netanyahu's office said.

"The prime minister heard late at night from the mayor of Jerusalem on the decision taken on the issue...the prime minister is working to prevent implementation of the plan," Netanyahu's office said in a hastily prepared statement.

Israel Television reported late on Thursday that a Jerusalem planning committee had given a permit to Irwin Moskowitz, a U.S. Jewish businessman who bankrolls Jewish settlement in occupied areas, to build tens of Jewish homes in Ras al-Amoud neighbourhood.
"He is permitted to build tomorrow and it is impossible to halt it," the television reported. Palestinians have called the plan a "time bomb".
The move comes with Israeli-PLO peace talks deep in crisis and Middle East tensions high over Israel's construction of a new Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.

Israel's Jerusalem municipal planning commission in December gave penultimate approval for the plan, sparking Palestinian warnings that final approval of the plan to house Jews in the heart of the neighbourhood of 11,000 Arabs could ignite violence.
